{"metadata":{"description":"VS Code companion extension for dsh-TUI — an experience almost identical to the official Claude Code VS Code extension","id":"gh:1335391417","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-tui-vscode","slug":"baobaolaodie/dsh-tui-vscode","topics":["ai-coding","deepseek","dsh-plugin","dsh-tui","terminal","vs-code-extension"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"VS Code companion extension for dsh-TUI — an experience almost identical to the official Claude Code"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"extension for dsh-TUI — an experience almost identical to the official Claude Code VS Code extension"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**dsh-tui-vscode** runs `dsh-tui` inside a **real VS Code integrated terminal** — the same shape as "},{"id":"p3s2","text":"the terminal mode of the official Claude Code VS Code extension (`createTerminal` plus running the C"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"LI inside it). No webview, no xterm emulation: just your shell, your fonts, and the full TUI."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"One click opens a **new column beside your editor**. Click again and you get another concurrent sess"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ion; the first one keeps running. The sidebar lists the sessions of the workspace you have open, and"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" clicking one resumes exactly that session."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it looks like"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Click the whale in the editor title bar and a **DeepSeek** terminal opens on the Beside column, runn"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ing dsh-tui in your shell — a real terminal, a real shell, the full TUI:"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Click again and you get another session in its own column; nothing is reused and nothing is killed f"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"or you. Here two of them run side by side, both showing dsh-tui v0.15.0:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"The sidebar lists the sessions of the workspace you have open, with titles and relative times. One c"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"lick resumes that session; hovering offers archive and rename, and right-click deletes permanently. "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"(The session titles in this capture are pixelated — they name real work.)"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"And selecting code in the editor reaches the running session without copy-paste. Here the editor rep"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"orts a selection in VS Code's status bar, and the TUI answers with the line count it received:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**1 — Install the CLI and the TUI.** Both are npm packages; the first launch bootstraps the dsh-tui "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"profile and needs `pnpm` on `PATH`:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Node **^22.19 or >= 24** is required."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**2 — Install the extension.** Search `dsh-tui` in the Extensions view (`Ctrl+Shift+X`) and install "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"**dsh-tui (VS Code)**, or open the Marketplace listing. To build from source instead you need the `c"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"**, or open the Marketplace listing. To build from source instead you need the `code` CLI on `PATH`:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"**3 — Give it a model.** Either export `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` before launching VS Code, or sign in from "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"inside the TUI with `/auth login deepseek-account` (DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 and newer); other providers are r"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"eachable through `/provider` or `/auth`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **A real terminal, not an emulation** — sessions run in the VS Code integrated terminal with your "},{"id":"p18s2","text":"default shell, so shell integration, Ctrl+C, copy/paste, fonts and theme all behave natively.
- **Be"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"side by default** — a new column next to the one you are working in (`ViewColumn.Beside`), never on "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"top of it. `dsh-tui-vscode.terminalLocation` switches to the current column (`active`) or the bottom"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" panel (`panel`).
- **As many concurrent sessions as you want** — each start opens a new terminal; n"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"othing is reused and nothing is killed for you.
- **A session sidebar that knows your workspace** — "},{"id":"p18s7","text":"titles, relative times, and one click to resume; hover to archive or rename, right-click to delete p"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"ermanently.
- **Your selection, without copy-paste** — select code and it reaches the running TUI ov"},{"id":"p18s9","text":"er the IDE selection channel, or press `Ctrl+Alt+K` to insert an explicit `@relative/path#L12-14` re"},{"id":"p18s10","text":"ference.
- **Start, resume, stop** — resume the last session or any session from the sidebar, and cl"},{"id":"p18s11","text":"ose a tab to end just that one."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The extension is a thin companion; the features below live in dsh-tui itself, so each one has a mini"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" thin companion; the features below live in dsh-tui itself, so each one has a minimum version there."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Capability | Requires |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| The extension as a whole | VS Code **≥ 1.90.0**, `dsh` CLI and `dsh-tui` installed globally |
| `@"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"path#L12-14` line ranges in mentions | dsh-tui **≥ 0.9.1** — older builds report the file as missing"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" |
| Raster images in the terminal (`sixel`, `none`) | dsh-tui **≥ 0.10.0**; see terminal images |
|"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" Automatic selection context (IDE selection channel, protocol v2) | dsh-tui **≥ 0.11.0** |
| Startup"},{"id":"p22s5","text":" recovery of a failed first connection (connect-phase retry) | a dsh-tui build that includes the ups"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"tream startup retry — **none released yet**; older builds dial once and give up for the session |
| "},{"id":"p22s7","text":"The extension side of the above | dsh-tui-vscode **≥ 0.7.0** for the selection channel, **≥ 0.7.5** "},{"id":"p22s8","text":"for the image protocol variable |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Beyond its minimum, dsh-tui is free to move: these two interfaces were re-checked against 0.15.0 and"},{"id":"p23s2","text":" had not changed since the versions above."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **Session = real terminal.** The extension only calls `createTerminal` and sends the launch comman"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"d; the process, its signals, its scrollback and its clipboard are all the terminal's. The launch com"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"mand is resolved to an absolute path against the **extension host's** PATH, because a login shell re"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"builds `PATH` and cannot be trusted.
- **Specific-session resume goes through the environment.** The"},{"id":"p25s5","text":" session id is exported as `DSH_TUI_RESUME_SESSION` and read at boot by the profile's `cordis.patch."},{"id":"p25s6","text":"yml`. `--resume` is deliberately *not* passed on that path — a bare `--resume` makes the launcher ov"},{"id":"p25s7","text":"erwrite the variable from `~/.dsh-tui/resume.txt`.
- **The sidebar reads the logs, tolerantly.** Ses"},{"id":"p25s8","text":"sion logs are concatenated multi-frame zstd; the extension decodes them frame by frame from a bounde"},{"id":"p25s9","text":"d 64 KB head and 128 KB tail, and falls back through the log's `session/title` event, the dsh storag"},{"id":"p25s10","text":"e ledger, the first human prompt, and finally the working directory name."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Commands"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Command Palette entries are grouped under **`dsh-tui`**. Titles follow your VS Code display language"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ommand Palette entries are grouped under **`dsh-tui`**. Titles follow your VS Code display language."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Command | What it does |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| `dsh-tui: Start new session` | Opens a new terminal and runs dsh-tui in it |
| `dsh-tui: Resume la"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"st session` | Runs dsh-tui with `--resume` (reads `~/.dsh-tui/resume.txt`) |
| `dsh-tui: Open dsh-TU"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"I` | The editor-title-bar button; same as starting a session |
| `dsh-tui: Focus session panel` | Br"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"ings the most recent session terminal to the front, starting one if there is none |
| `dsh-tui: Resu"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"me session` | Resumes the session selected in the sidebar |
| `dsh-tui: Insert @-mention` | Types th"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"e current file or selection into the session terminal — or copies it, if there is no session termina"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"l |
| `dsh-tui: Terminate session` | Sends Ctrl+C to the most recent session terminal |
